dtsPropsFor.HubList:
/** Grouped rows; each row is a 52px link with an icon, a label, an optional detail line and a count when something is waiting. Every `icon` is a rendered lucide element, never the component. */
  sections: { section: string; rows: { href: string; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode; detail?: string; badge?: number }[] }[];
dtsPropsFor.MobileTabBar:
/** Up to five tabs. `match` lists the pathname prefixes that count as being on the tab; `moreFallback` marks the tab that lights when nothing matches. */
  tabs: { href: string; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode; match: string[]; moreFallback?: boolean; badge?: number }[];
dtsPropsFor.NounTabs:
/** One group per door; the strip shows the group whose door the current path is inside. Overview first, then the rows. */
  groups: { key: "diary" | "people" | "clubhouse" | "money" | "inbox" | "messages"; tabs: { href: string; label: string; badge?: number }[] }[];
dtsPropsFor.Skeleton:
/** Size each bar — `h-4 w-1/3` — because only the caller knows the shape of what is arriving. Build the loading state in the shape of the screen, not as one grey block. The bars are `aria-hidden`: announce the wait once, with `aria-busy` on the region around them. */
  className?: string;
